r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing 415V Switchroom
r.Description: Transportable switchroom complete with 1.8m legs and landings, transported to site 600kms on sealed roads.

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing 415V Switchroom Landings and Stairs
r.Description: Equipment Landing to be structural steel baseframe complete with 1.8m legs, designed to support heaviest piece of equipment to be installed in room.

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing LV Switchroom Transformer cubicle
r.Description: Separate dry transformer enclosure with removable wall panel and personnel access door Fortress key locked (Keyed alike) with 33kV feeder earth switch on F00-SW-010 33kV switchgear
r.Comments: Access to transformer cubicle is only possible with 33kV Feeder isolated and earthed. Switchroom manufacturer to coordinate Fortress keys with TEKSAL.

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing LV Switchroom Transformer cubicle
r.Description: TRANSFORMER ENCLOSURE F13-TR-014 33,000/433 VOLTS (Modify to suit) DANGER – HIGH VOLTAGE (with the lightning bolt sign) NO UNAUTHORISED ACCESS – ENSURE SUPPLY IS ISOLATED AND EARTHED PRIOR TO ENTRY ISOLATE AT F00-SW-010, PANEL BXX (BXX being the 33kV panel/tier number)
r.Comments: Signage to be placed on outside of transformer enclosure

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing 415V MCC Transformer
r.Comments: Vendor to remove wheels and secure transformer once installed. Wheels to be stored securely within the transformer room. Vendor to bolt down/brace for transport. Refer transformer GAs.

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing 415V MCC
r.Description: Demountable Form 4a double sided 415V Switchboard, 4000A bus, 65kA/1s fault rating, internal arc fault containment.
r.Comments: Vendor to install free issued network switches in MCC Refer datasheet 2000-F00-DSH-EL-11008

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing Esential 415V Switchboard
r.Description: Demountable Form 4a single sided 415V Essential Switchboard, 400A bus, 65kA/1s fault rating, internal arc fault containment.

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing 415V Switchroom L&SP Distribution Board
r.Description: 415V 3Ø 250A DB. Fitted with incoming isolator, PE Cell circuit (night/day), Auto / Manual selector, Emergency light test controller, Rapidtest RCD test units, Lighting Contactors, air conditioner Contactors and DB Legend. Incomer and circuit breakers to be padlockable in the off position.
r.Comments: In accordance to Drawing 2000-F00-STD-EL-10025 & 2000-F00-STD-EL-10022; Switchroom Vendor to calculate number of required poles including the number of circuits for Air conditioners, 20% loaded Spare circuit breakers and 20% spare space.

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing 415V Switchroom 240V UPS Distribution Board
r.Description: 240VAC 250A UPS DB. Fitted with incoming isolator and DB Legend. Incomer and circuit breakers to be padlockable in the off position.
r.Comments: In accordance to Drawing 2000-F00-STD-EL-10027. Switchroom Vendor to calculate number of required poles including 20% loaded Spare circuit breakers and 20% spare space.

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing 415V Switchroom 240VAC UPS
r.Description: LV Switchroom 240V AC, 10kVA UPS, free-standing. 8 hours autonomy time. 3-Phase in / 1-Phase Out.
r.Comments: 10kVA/10kW Sentryum Xtend UPS - 3 Phase in- 1 out. Vendor to secure wheels once installed. Vendor to bolt down/brace for transport. W: 440mm, D: 840mm, H: 1320mm, Weight: 103Kg

r.Equipment Name: Recycle Crushing 415V Switchroom 240VAC UPS Battery Bank
r.Description: UPS Battery Cabinet w/ 40 x 55Ah batteries
r.Comments: 480V Extension Battery Cabinet with 40 x 55Ah Long life batteries. Cabinet shipped empty with the batteries packed separately W: 860mm, D: 800mm, H: 1900mm, Weight: 900Kg

r.Description: Transportable switchroom on structural steel baseframe complete with 1.8m legs and landings, transported to site 600kms on sealed roads.

r.Description: Equipment Landing to be structural steel baseframe complete with 1.8m legs and landings, designed to support heaviest piece of equipment to be installed in room.

r.Equipment Name: Ultra Fine Grinding 11kV Switchboard
r.Description: Metal clad, partition metal, 11kV switchboard. 1250A bus, 25kA/3s fault rating. Internally arc fault contained AFLR. With top mount arc absorbing duct on top - no arc vent to outdoors. 1 x VT/Earth Switch panel, 1 x Incomer panel, 2 x Motor feeder panels, 1 x Spare Feeder panel
r.Comments: Refer 2000-EL003-B02-10012 (Panel Arrangement), 2000-EL003-B03-10004 (Section View), 2000-EL003-C01-10011 (Foundation Frame Detail), 2000-EL003-C03-10010 (Foundation Layout), 2000-EL003-D01-10004 (SLD) 2000-F00-DSH-EL-11003 11kV Datasheet Switchboard Dimensions (W = 3310mm, H = 2533mm, D = 1340mm) approx. weight 4,250kg

r.Description: 48V DC Tripping and Closing Supply, 200Ah battery bank. Free-standing industrial cabinet.
r.Comments: 1 x U220 Battery enclosure (W:800mm, D: 800mm, H: 2200mm). IP-42, Bottom cable entry, 5mm Aluminium gland plate complete with 1 string of 4 X 12V 200Ah VRLA Batteries. And all associated accessories.

r.Equipment Name: Ultra Fine Grinding 11kV Switchroom 48VDC Charger
r.Description: 48V DC Tripping and Closing Supply, with 100A charger complete with integral DB. Free-standing industrial cabinet.
r.Comments: 1 x U220 Battery enclosure (W:800mm, D: 800mm, H: 2200mm). 100A MCRII 3 Phase input charger. Compete with: Alarm relay board (voltage free alarm relays, including Floating Earth Fault). Blocking Diode Communications Board (For Modbus TCP) Including Lifting lugs, battery test facility, 1 hour battery discharge test, and integrated DC DB with 8 off 2P, 20A MCBs and 1 spare MCB with shunt trip.
